menu.heading: Welcome to the Arena
menu.description: Choose a combat style, master an original champion, and command the field in a fast tactical battle.
menu.tagline: Your champion. Your call. Your arena.

select.heading: Choose Your Champion
select.empty: Select a champion to view their kit.
select.pickHint: Pick your champion, then choose or randomize an opponent.

battle.title: Arena Battle
battle.controlsHint: Left/right-click to move · A then click to attack-move · S to stop · Q/W/E/R to cast
battle.loadError: The battle renderer could not start. Return to champion select and try again.

result.title: Match Result
result.winSubtitle: The arena is yours. Glory to the champion.
result.loseSubtitle: The core has fallen. Regroup and try again.

mode.heading: Choose Your Battlefield
mode.hint: Each arena rewards a different rhythm. Pick one to continue to champion selection.
mode.conquestDesc: A full tactical campaign across three lanes, with structures, minion waves, jungle threats, and major objectives.
mode.midlineDesc: A focused single-lane skirmish with a random roster, rapid encounters, and constant team fights.

shop.title: Item Shop
shop.checkoutNote: Build cost credits owned components for planning; each purchase still uses its listed shop price.

huntersRelic.name: Hunter's Relic
huntersRelic.desc: A sturdy starter granting a little health and attack damage for the early game.

swiftBoots.name: Swift Boots
swiftBoots.desc: Lightweight boots that greatly increase your movement speed.

shortsword.name: Shortsword
shortsword.desc: A basic blade that adds a modest amount of attack damage.

sunfireGreatblade.name: Sunfire Greatblade
sunfireGreatblade.desc: A legendary blade granting heavy attack damage, attack speed and cooldown reduction.

emberRod.name: Ember Rod
emberRod.desc: A smoldering rod that grants a solid boost to ability power.

archmageCrown.name: Archmage Crown
archmageCrown.desc: A legendary crown granting huge ability power, mana and cooldown reduction.

ironVest.name: Iron Vest
ironVest.desc: Heavy plating that grants bonus health and armor.

aegisColossus.name: Aegis of the Colossus
aegisColossus.desc: A legendary bulwark granting massive health, armor and cooldown reduction.

vampiricEdge.name: Vampiric Edge
vampiricEdge.desc: A hungry blade granting attack damage and attack speed for sustained fights.

bloodreaver.name: Bloodreaver
bloodreaver.desc: A legendary lifesteal weapon granting heavy attack damage, attack speed and health.

manaCrystal.name: Mana Crystal
manaCrystal.desc: A crystal that expands your resource pool and trims cooldowns.

chronoCore.name: Chrono Core
chronoCore.desc: A legendary core granting a huge resource pool, ability power and cooldown reduction.

hud.statusDefeated: You were defeated. Respawn in {{seconds}} seconds.
hud.statusRespawned: You have respawned with brief protection.
hud.statusHardCap: The hard cap has been reached; the match will resolve by score.

diagnostics.title: Privacy & Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Optional, coarse performance and crash signals stay on this device. Nothing is uploaded; data leaves only when you export it.
diagnostics.enabled: Enabled. Collection is local and privacy-safe.
diagnostics.disabled: Off by default. No diagnostics are being collected.
diagnostics.blocked: Blocked by your browser's Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track setting.

keybinds.attackMove: Arm attack-move for the next battlefield click
keybinds.stop: Stop and clear the current target

P.name: Cinder Mark
P.desc: Every third basic attack burns the target, dealing bonus fire damage over 2 seconds.

Q.name: Piercing Arrow
Q.desc: Fire a charged arrow in a line that pierces the first enemy it strikes, dealing heavy damage.

W.name: Scattering Volley
W.desc: Loose a fan of arrows across an area, damaging all enemies caught within.

E.name: Nimble Roll
E.desc: Roll a short distance, refreshing Cinder Mark and gaining brief attack speed.

R.name: Sunfall Barrage
R.desc: Channel a devastating long-range arrow that detonates on the first enemy hit, dealing massive damage.

P.name: Shadowstep
P.desc: Attacks from behind an enemy deal bonus damage and briefly grant camouflage out of combat.

Q.name: Twin Fang
Q.desc: Strike with paired daggers in a short cone, dealing burst physical damage.

W.name: Smoke Cloak
W.desc: Vanish into smoke, becoming untargetable for a moment and gaining movement speed.

E.name: Phantom Lunge
E.desc: Dash to a target location, slashing the first enemy passed for damage.

R.name: Killing Shadow
R.desc: Blink behind the lowest-health enemy and unleash an execute strike for massive damage.

P.name: Living Fortress
P.desc: Gains stacking armor the longer Ironhold stays in combat, up to a hardened cap.

Q.name: Shield Bash
Q.desc: Slam the ground with a shield, damaging and slowing nearby enemies.

W.name: Bracing Wall
W.desc: Raise a bulwark that grants a temporary shield absorbing incoming damage.

E.name: Grappling Charge
E.desc: Charge forward to the first enemy hit, dealing damage and knocking them back.

R.name: Seismic Anchor
R.desc: Drive an anchor into the earth, stunning all nearby enemies and dealing damage.

P.name: Kindling
P.desc: Damaging spells leave embers that ignite for extra magic damage on the next hit.

Q.name: Flame Bolt
Q.desc: Hurl a bolt of fire in a line, dealing magic damage to the first enemy struck.

W.name: Meteor Fall
W.desc: Call a meteor onto a target area, dealing heavy magic damage to everyone in the blast.

E.name: Searing Chains
E.desc: Bind an enemy in fiery chains, rooting them in place and dealing damage over time.

R.name: Infernal Nova
R.desc: Unleash a ring of fire that erupts outward, dealing catastrophic magic damage around Embermage.

P.name: Guiding Light
P.desc: Healing an ally also grants them a small burst of movement speed toward Dawnsong.

Q.name: Starlance
Q.desc: Send a bolt of starlight in a line, dealing magic damage to the first enemy it hits.

W.name: Mending Chorus
W.desc: Restore health to a targeted ally and cleanse a minor slow effect.

E.name: Aegis Hymn
E.desc: Shield an ally and briefly increase their movement speed to reposition safely.

R.name: Dawnbreak
R.desc: Bathe all nearby allies in dawnlight, healing them greatly and briefly boosting their defenses.

P.name: Barbed Hide
P.desc: Nearby enemies that strike Thornwarden are pricked by thorns, taking a little damage back.

Q.name: Bramble Sweep
Q.desc: Swing a mass of thorned vines around Thornwarden, damaging and briefly slowing nearby enemies.

W.name: Rooted Stance
W.desc: Plant firmly for a moment, gaining bonus armor and cleansing slows while the stance holds.

E.name: Creeping Vine
E.desc: Whip a vine in a line that damages the first enemy struck and pulls Thornwarden toward them.

R.name: Grove Uprising
R.desc: Erupt a ring of grasping roots that stuns and damages every enemy caught around Thornwarden.

P.name: Blood Scent
P.desc: Grimtrail sees wounded enemies more clearly and deals bonus damage to targets below half health.

Q.name: Rending Claw
Q.desc: Lash out with claws in a short line, dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit.

W.name: Savage Pounce
W.desc: Leap onto a nearby area, clawing all enemies beneath on landing for burst damage.

E.name: Thicket Dash
E.desc: Dash a short distance through the brush, gaining brief movement speed after the leap.

R.name: Hunter's Verdict
R.desc: Blink to a marked enemy and unleash a flurry of strikes, dealing massive damage over a moment.

P.name: Chillscript
P.desc: Frostquill's spells etch frost on targets, slowing the next attack the target attempts.

Q.name: Glacier Bolt
Q.desc: Fire a shard of ice in a line, dealing magic damage to the first enemy it strikes.

W.name: Hailstorm
W.desc: Call falling ice over a target area, dealing magic damage to everyone caught in the fall.

E.name: Frozen Verse
E.desc: Inscribe a rune beneath an enemy that freezes them in place for a short time.

R.name: Absolute Winter
R.desc: Send a sweeping wave of rime across a long line, dealing heavy magic damage to all it passes.

P.name: Fading Light
P.desc: Every fourth basic attack fires a twilight bolt that deals bonus damage at long range.

Q.name: Gloom Shot
Q.desc: Loose a swift arrow in a line that deals damage to the first enemy it passes through.

W.name: Nettle Trap
W.desc: Scatter thorned caltrops over an area that damage and slow enemies who step across them.

E.name: Backstep
E.desc: Vault a short distance away, resetting Duskarrow's spacing and refreshing attack rhythm.

R.name: Eventide Volley
R.desc: Fire a piercing twilight arrow across the battlefield, dealing massive damage to the first enemy hit.

P.name: Kindled Watch
P.desc: Allies standing near Wardlight slowly recover a trickle of health from the lantern's glow.

Q.name: Beacon Bolt
Q.desc: Send a mote of light in a line, dealing magic damage to the first enemy it reaches.

W.name: Soothing Glow
W.desc: Bathe a targeted ally in warm light, restoring a chunk of their health.

E.name: Warding Flare
E.desc: Flash a burst of light at an enemy, briefly blinding and stunning them in place.

R.name: Lantern Vigil
R.desc: Raise a great lantern that shields and hastens all nearby allies for a short while.
